title: Fix Caption Center Line Spacing
summary: Fixed German caption_bar and beat/title text at the shared helpers so every Heating/Cooling video gets center-aligned multi-line subtitles, a stable CAPTION_FONT_SIZE (no auto-shrink), and a fixed vertical line gap. Root cause was caption_bar scaling long lines and building multi-line copy as one Pango Text, which left-aligned lines and let Georgia metrics regress on each scene rewrite.
